title: ITSE-1311 PHP Variables and Data Quiz

questions.question: Which statements are true concerning variables? Select all that apply. Choices: Used for a short span of time; Used to reference pieces of information; Expected to change value as the script runs; Created and used when a script runs.
With PHP, we do not have to tell the computer what type of information we are going to keep in a variable. Choices: True; False.

Which statements are true concerning PHP variable formatting? Select all that apply. Choices: Can begin with a number; Can have a space; Typically has an underscore (_) as a second character; Must begin with a dollar sign ($).
Which type of variable can have a value of 0 or 1? Choices: Floating; Integer; String; Boolean.
Which type of variables are whole numbers (1, 3, 20, etc.)? Choices: String; Integer; Boolean; Floating.
Which type of variables are decimal values (1.33, 34.2325)? Choices: Boolean; Floating; String; Integer.
Which type of variables contain any number of characters? Choices: Floating; Boolean; Integer; String.
Which is a structured list of information? Choices: Object; Array; NULL; Resource.
Which is an empty (unused or unset) variable? Choices: Object; Array; Resource; NULL.
Semicolons at the end of each line are not necessary. Choices: True; False.
Which holds information about a user's visit? Select all that apply. Choices: $_FILES; $_ENV; $_COOKIE; $_SESSION.
Which holds information about the server? Choices: $_COOKIE; $_FILES; $_ENV; $_SESSION.
Which statements will increment a counter by one? Select all that apply. Choices: $counter++; $counter = 1 + 1; $counter = $counter + 1; $counter += 1.
Which statements are true concerning constants? Select all that apply. Choices: Cannot embed in a string; Starts with dollar sign; Some are predefined; Does not change.
Which character concatenates strings and variables? Choices: at sign (@); period (.); addition sign (+); ampersand (&).
Which statements are true concerning arrays? Select all that apply. Choices: Starts with 1; Can be numeric or associative; Stores multiple values in one variable; Starts with 0.
In the following array, which position is cat? array("dog", "cat", "bird", "snake", "guinea pig"). Choices: $theGriffins[2]; $theGriffins[3]; $theGriffins[1]; $theGriffins[0].
Which statements are true concerning $_POST and $_GET? Select all that apply. Choices: They are arrays; Used by forms to transmit data; Always available; They are reserved variables.

Which statements are true concerning cookies? Select all that apply. Choices: Stores small files on the user's computer; Must pass information using forms; Used to store and use information from any page on our site; Must use special links.

Which statements are true concerning sessions? Select all that apply. Choices: Stores information on the server; Sessions can be used with cookies simultaneously; Stores information on the user's computer; Will work when the user blocks cookies.
